_note: QIE projects with live mainnet contracts, taken from their public GitHub READMEs on 18 Nov 2026. Shared contracts (e.g. a price feed several projects reference) are left out. Check each list before seeding.

projects.name: Fluenci
projects.description: Non-custodial subscriptions on QIE: plain-dollar pricing, a spending cap only the subscriber can raise, one-tap cancel, settled in QUSDC.

projects.name: RemitChain
projects.description: Remittances on QIE: recipients claim without a wallet through a gasless relayer, secured with passkeys (WebAuthn).

projects.name: Patungan
projects.description: Group payments with a deadline on QIE: QUSDC escrow, join by swapping on QIEDEX, automatic refunds if the deadline passes.

projects.name: Semilla1 Guard
projects.description: On-chain spending guard for AI agents on QIE: limits what an agent's wallet can spend.
